pinyin: zhī cuò néng gǎi, shàn mò dà yān
literal: know · wrong · can · correct, goodness · none · greater · (particle)
natural: to know your fault and mend it is the greatest virtue

meaning.en: Admitting a mistake and correcting it is the finest thing a person can do.
meaning.zh: 认识到错误并加以改正，是最好不过的事。

equivalents: to err is human, to correct it is noble
a fault confessed is half redressed

examples.zh: 知错能改，善莫大焉，他主动向同学道了歉。
examples.en: To know one's fault and mend it is the greatest virtue, and he apologised to his classmates of his own accord.

examples.zh: 老师常说：知错能改，善莫大焉，犯错不可怕。
examples.en: The teacher often says that mending your ways is the highest goodness, and that making mistakes is nothing to fear.

usage.en: Used to comfort or encourage someone who has owned up to a mistake. It is a modern rewording of a line in 《左传》 (人谁无过？过而能改，善莫大焉).
usage.zh: 用来安慰、鼓励认错的人。由《左传》“人谁无过？过而能改，善莫大焉”改写而来。

synonyms: 不惜以今日之我难昔日之我

pinyin: tuán jié jiù shì lì liàng

meaning.en: People who stand together achieve far more than they could alone.
meaning.zh: 大家团结一致，就能发挥出巨大的力量。

equivalents: unity is strength
united we stand

examples.zh: 团结就是力量，只要全班一条心，就没有克服不了的困难。
examples.en: Unity is strength: if the whole class is of one mind, no difficulty is insurmountable.

examples.zh: 球队靠着团结就是力量的信念，逆转了比分。
examples.en: Buoyed by the belief that unity is strength, the team turned the score around.

usage.en: A modern slogan, familiar from a well-known 1943 song of the same name. Common in speeches, banners and school assemblies; neutral to formal.
usage.zh: 现代口号，广为人知的同名歌曲创作于1943年。常见于演讲、标语和校园活动，中性偏书面。

synonyms: 一根筷子易折，十根筷子难断

pinyin: tuán jié qǐ lái lì liàng dà

meaning.en: When people join forces they become strong.
meaning.zh: 大家联合起来，力量就大。

equivalents: many hands make light work
strength in numbers

examples.zh: 团结起来力量大，咱们一起把这堆活干完。
examples.en: Many hands make light work; let's finish this pile together.

examples.zh: 大家别各干各的，团结起来力量大。
examples.en: Let's not each go our own way; there's strength in numbers.

usage.en: A plain, everyday way of urging cooperation; close in meaning to 团结就是力量 but more casual and childlike, a favourite in primary-school songs and slogans.
usage.zh: 日常劝人合作的说法，意思近于“团结就是力量”，更口语化，常见于儿歌和小学标语。

pinyin: péng you duō le lù hǎo zǒu
natural: with many friends the road is easy to travel

meaning.en: The more friends you have, the more help is at hand and the easier life becomes.
meaning.zh: 朋友多了，遇事有人帮忙，办事就顺利。

equivalents: the more friends, the smoother the road
it's who you know

examples.zh: 朋友多了路好走，出门在外多交几个朋友总没坏处。
examples.en: The more friends the smoother the road, so it never hurts to make a few more when you're away from home.

examples.zh: 他人缘好，真是朋友多了路好走。
examples.en: He's very popular: truly, many friends make the road easy.

usage.en: Often quoted with approval in business and social settings; the full saying is 多个朋友多条路. Occasionally used to excuse networking.
usage.zh: 多用于称赞广交朋友，常与“多个朋友多条路”并说；有时也用来为拉关系辩解。

synonyms: 在家靠父母，出门靠朋友

pinyin: xiǎo rén zhī jiāo gān ruò lǐ
literal: petty man · 's · friendship · sweet · like · sweet wine
natural: a petty man's friendship is as sweet as sweet wine

meaning.en: Friendship between self-seeking people is sugary on the surface but built on advantage, so it does not last.
meaning.zh: 势利之人的交情表面热络甜蜜，实则基于利益，难以长久。

equivalents: fair-weather friendship
friends only while it pays

examples.zh: 小人之交甘若醴，酒桌上称兄道弟，出了事谁都不见人影。
examples.en: A petty man's friendship is sweet as wine: they call each other brother over drinks, then vanish when trouble comes.

examples.zh: 他明白小人之交甘若醴的道理，所以不轻信奉承。
examples.en: He knows that shallow friendships are sweet but empty, so he is wary of flattery.

story.en: Zhuangzi says: 'The friendship of a gentleman is as plain as water; the friendship of a petty man is as sweet as sweet wine. The gentleman's plainness leads to closeness, the petty man's sweetness leads to rupture.'
story.zh: 《庄子·山木》：“君子之交淡若水，小人之交甘若醴；君子淡以亲，小人甘以绝。”

date.zh: 战国中期 · 前4—前3世纪

usage.en: The second half of a famous pair, usually followed or preceded by 君子之交淡如水. 醴 (lǐ) is sweet fermented drink. Literary.
usage.zh: 通常与“君子之交淡如水”对举。“醴”指甜酒。书面语。

natural: a tiger father has no dog son

meaning.en: Capable, distinguished parents tend to raise capable children.
meaning.zh: 父亲能干，儿子也不会差。

equivalents: like father, like son
a chip off the old block

examples.zh: 他爸是冠军，他也拿了金牌，真是虎父无犬子。
examples.en: His father was a champion and he has won gold too: a real chip off the old block.

examples.zh: 大家都夸这位年轻导演虎父无犬子。
examples.en: Everyone praises the young director as worthy of his famous father.

usage.en: Mostly said in praise of a son (occasionally a daughter), usually as a compliment to the father too. It may sound sexist to some today; 虎母无犬女 is sometimes jokingly said.
usage.zh: 多用来称赞儿子不负父辈威名，同时也是对父亲的夸奖。今天有人觉得带性别色彩，有时戏说“虎母无犬女”。

synonyms: 龙生龙，凤生凤，老鼠的儿子会打洞

text: 江山代有才人出，各领风骚数百年
pinyin: jiāng shān dài yǒu cái rén chū, gè lǐng fēng sāo shù bǎi nián
literal: rivers · mountains · generation · have · talented · people · emerge, each · lead · fashion · several · hundred · years
natural: Every age brings forth its talents, each leading the field for a time

meaning.en: Every generation produces its own outstanding people, and each one sets the tone for a while before the next comes along.
meaning.zh: 每个时代都有杰出人才出现，各自引领潮流一段时间。

equivalents: each generation has its own stars
every age has its own talents

examples.zh: “江山代有才人出，各领风骚数百年”，我们应相信年轻人能创造新的辉煌。
examples.en: '江山代有才人出，各领风骚数百年': we should trust that young people can create new glories.

examples.zh: 老一辈科学家说“江山代有才人出，各领风骚数百年”，鼓励后辈超越他们。
examples.en: The older scientists say '江山代有才人出，各领风骚数百年', encouraging the younger generation to surpass them.

story.en: The Qing poet Zhao Yi wrote on poetry: 'Li Bai and Du Fu's verses have been on ten thousand lips, yet today they seem no longer fresh. Every age sees its own talents emerge, each leading the field for hundreds of years.' He meant that every era needs its own new voices.
story.zh: 清代诗人赵翼《论诗五首》其二：“李杜诗篇万口传，至今已觉不新鲜。江山代有才人出，各领风骚数百年。”意谓每个时代都应有自己的新声。

usage.en: Often quoted in graduation speeches, sport and tech news. The first half alone is also common; the second half is usually added for the sense of 'each in turn'.
usage.zh: 常用于毕业致辞、体育和科技报道。也常只引前半句，后半句强调“各领一时”。

synonyms: 李杜诗篇万口传，至今已觉不新鲜

variants: 百善孝为先，万恶淫为首
literal: hundred · good deeds · filial piety · is · first
natural: of all virtues, filial piety comes first

meaning.en: Of all the virtues, respect and care for one's parents should come first.
meaning.zh: 在所有美德中，孝敬父母应摆在第一位。

equivalents: filial piety comes first
honour thy father and mother

examples.zh: 百善孝为先，不管多忙，都要常回家看看父母。
examples.en: Of all virtues filial piety comes first: however busy you are, visit your parents often.

examples.zh: 社区开展了“百善孝为先”主题活动。
examples.en: The community held an event on the theme 'filial piety comes first'.

usage.en: Often paired with 万恶淫为首 in the older form, but today the second half is rarely quoted and the first half is used alone. It draws on the Confucian idea that 孝 is the root of virtue.
usage.zh: 旧时常与“万恶淫为首”连说，如今多只用前半句。体现儒家以孝为德之本的观念。

pinyin: mǔ xíng qiān lǐ ér bù chóu
literal: mother · travel · thousand · li · son · not · worry
natural: when mother travels a thousand li, the child does not worry

meaning.en: The counterpart to 'a mother worries when her child is away': children often take it lightly when it is their mother who goes far.
meaning.zh: 与“儿行千里母担忧”相对，说子女对母亲远行往往不那么挂心。

equivalents: a mother worries more than the child does
out of sight, out of mind

examples.zh: 儿行千里母担忧，母行千里儿不愁，这话听着真让人心酸。
examples.en: 'A mother worries when her son is far away, but a son doesn't worry when his mother is': it's sad to hear.

examples.zh: 母行千里儿不愁，他说得轻松，却没想到妈妈每天都在等电话。
examples.en: He said casually that a son doesn't worry when his mother travels, never realising how she waited for his calls every day.

usage.en: Normally the second line of the couplet 儿行千里母担忧，母行千里儿不愁. Said wistfully about the imbalance of parents' and children's concern; sometimes as a gentle reproach.
usage.zh: 通常是对联“儿行千里母担忧，母行千里儿不愁”的下句。感叹父母与子女牵挂不对等，有时含轻微责备。

pinyin: fù mǔ zài, bù yuǎn yóu
variants: 父母在，不远游，游必有方
natural: while your parents live, do not travel far

meaning.en: While your parents are alive, do not travel far from them; if you must go, tell them where.
meaning.zh: 父母在世，不要出远门；如要出门，须有一定的去向。

equivalents: stay close while your parents are alive
don't wander far from ageing parents

examples.zh: “父母在，不远游”，可现代人为了工作，不得不远走他乡。
examples.en: '父母在，不远游', but modern people must leave their hometown for work.

examples.zh: 他引用“父母在，不远游”，婉拒了去外地发展的机会。
examples.en: He quoted '父母在，不远游' to politely decline an opportunity in another city.

story.en: Confucius says: 'While your parents are alive, do not travel far; if you travel, it must be with a set destination.'
story.zh: 《论语·里仁》：子曰：“父母在，不远游，游必有方。”

usage.en: Today people often discuss whether the maxim still fits modern life; the full text continues 游必有方 ('go only with a definite destination'), meaning you must let your parents know where you are.
usage.zh: 今天人们常讨论这句话是否适应现代生活；原文下句“游必有方”，指出游须让父母知道去向。
